subject: prd/impl-review
statement: Before PR-raise, every blocking finding shall carry a recorded worker disposition — applied or disputed-with-reason; a blocking finding marked applied shall render as verified only after a round-2 re-review confirms the named defect closed, else the report shall label it an unverified claim and the verdict shall not upgrade on it.
rationale: D-3's findings-use half; closes the self-certified-applied hole
fit_criterion: fixtures: a raise with an undisposed blocking finding is a protocol defect; an applied-but-unverified blocking finding renders unverified and holds the verdict at request-changes
